notes.subject: מפיקים מזן אל זן
notes.rationale: 'furnishing produce of every kind to every kind' — read as 'supplying all manner of store' (KJV) or 'bringing out kind upon kind' (YLT).

notes.subject: מזוה
notes.rationale: מֶזֶו (granary) occurs only here in the Tanakh.

notes.subject: tausen na ten tausen
notes.rationale: כך אלפים / רבבות — thousands and myriads, numeric hyperbole of increase.

translation: Haus bilong keepim kaikai bilong yumi i ful, ol i bringautim kaikai long wanwan kain go long narapela kain; ol sipsip na meme bilong yumi i mekim ol i kamap ol tausen, ol ten tausen long ol rot bilong yumi.
